item.title: Admittedly over the top WW1 shooter is out now, and it's the one time the question of an anti-cheat solution sounds ridiculous
item.description: With plenty of monthly playtests under its belt, this new third-person WW1 shooter is doing things very differently with 200-player servers.

item.title: Last year was rough for Marvel Snap, but its new Foundational Focus promises more than a long-awaited game mode
item.description: With a new keyword out and one of many new game modes confirmed, 2022 breakout card game Marvel Snap wants to become your forever game.

item.title: Knockout codes March 2026
item.description: Get free spins, Disco Balls, and even some new skins for your penguins with this list of new Knockout codes for the wacky Roblox brawler.

item.title: Get nine underrated Steam Deck games at more than 91% off in this special 15th anniversary Humble Bundle
item.description: Humble celebrates 15 years with a new bundle featuring Steam Deck-friendly indies like Oddsparks, Inkbound, and Kill Knight.

item.title: JDM is a simple racer, but a love letter to Japanese car culture
item.description: JDM: Japanese Drift Master feels like a racing game from times gone by, but it's obviously passionate about Japanese car culture.

item.title: Bungie is fixing Marathon's worst microtransaction sin
item.description: Marathon microtransactions will now give enough Lux to buy runner skins, with Bungie discussing “ways to improve” its cosmetics offering.

item.title: A transformative Deadlock update just hit its entire roster with 850 lines of patch notes. Here are the biggest changes.
item.description: Valve’s transformative new Deadlock patch notes include skill reworks, item overhauls, movement changes, and fresh neutral camps on the map.

item.title: Rust's new boats just got a lot more customizable, with longer days to build them
item.description: The Rust Shipshape update adds more ways to tweak and improve your boats, along with the introduction of longer days in the survival game.

item.title: The Riftbreaker's explosive blend of co-op base building and Diablo-style action is free to try right now
item.description: The Riftbreaker’s combination of base-building survival game and high-octane ARPG just got bigger, and a free weekend lets you try it now.

item.title: This VPN ban is edging ever closer, and here's what it means for your privacy
item.description: A new consultation, which will conclude in May 2026, will determine whether or not there is a VPN ban for people under 18 in the UK.
